Command.Comment: RAGIN CORE app and listener inventory (safe commands)

commands:
echo RUN
date -u
echo APP_WALK
for d in /etc/ragin /opt/ragin /app /srv /var/lib/ragin /var/log/ragin; do
  if [ -d "$d" ]; then
    echo "DIR=$d"
    find "$d" -maxdepth 3 -type f 2>/dev/null | sed -E "s#^$d/##" | sort | head -n 200
  else
    echo "DIR_MISSING=$d"
  fi
done
echo PROCESS_HUNT
ps -eo pid,user,args --width 300 2>/dev/null | grep -iE 'ragin|server_v2|uvicorn|gunicorn|cowrie|socat|python|node|openssl|ssh' | grep -v grep | head -n 80 || true
echo LISTEN
if command -v ss >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  ss -tulpn 2>/dev/null | grep -iE '8443|24443|22|2222|50051|8080|8083|8731' || true
else
  echo "ss not present"
fi
echo AMAZON_LINUX_PKG_HINTS
if command -v dpkg >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  dpkg -l 2>/dev/null | grep -iE 'cowrie|ragin|openssl|python3-openssl|libssl|node' | head -n 80 || true
else
  echo "dpkg not present"
fi
echo OPENSSL_BIN
if command -v openssl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "openssl present: $(openssl version 2>/dev/null || true)"
else
  echo "openssl not present"
fi
echo OPENSSL_ENTROPY
if command -v openssl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  for p in s_client s_server x509 rand version; do
    openssl "$p" --help >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "openssl $p usable" || echo "openssl $p NOT usable"
  done
fi
echo DONE
